Villa renovation — Jeddah & GCC

Renovate an existing villa with clarity from first survey to execution drawings

Villa renovation is more than changing a facade or rearranging furniture. It requires a precise reading of what can remain, what must change, and how each decision becomes clear information for consultants and contractors. We begin with a free call and a free preliminary concept, with no paid agreement until alignment.

Request a free call WhatsApp

Understand the building before changing it

We review available records, the existing-condition survey, spatial relationships, levels and openings. A reliable starting point keeps the renovation from being designed around false assumptions.

Separate existing, demolition and construction work

We translate the redesign into a legible drawing sequence: what remains, what is removed and what is built. Depending on scope, this covers walls, openings, stairs, terraces and the new relationships between rooms.

A clear architectural execution package

The package brings together the plans, sections, elevations and architectural details needed to understand the interventions. Structural and MEP input is coordinated with the relevant specialists when included in the agreed scope.

Frequently asked questions about private villa design

Can a villa be renovated without demolishing it completely?

Often, yes. We identify what can remain and what needs intervention after reviewing the existing building, the family brief and structural specialist input where required.

Which drawings are included in a renovation package?

It depends on the agreed scope and may include existing, demolition, construction and furnished plans, together with sections, elevations and architectural details.

Does the service include structural and MEP drawings?

They are not automatically included. Required disciplines are defined in the proposal, and we coordinate with qualified specialists when those services form part of the scope.

Can you handle a renovation project remotely outside Jeddah?

Yes, provided there is an accurate building survey and reliable site information. We serve clients across Saudi Arabia and the Gulf remotely, with site visits arranged separately when needed.
